summary: Our project is a game for children between 6 and 10 years old. This game tells the story of a community of aliens who want to conquer the 8 planets of the solar system, the moon and exoplanets. They do this while collecting resources from each planet. The aliens must complete space missions to conquer the planets. If they fail these missions, a secondary mission will appear  so they can continue. The purpose is helping them to lear, not to make them feel disappointed or stressed. Also, there is a space for the parents, so they can see all the things that the children are learning. Children today struggle to pay attention and get bored learning new things. Our game is fun and easy for children to learn maths and information abut the planets, their position, composition and fun facts.
details: Our game was primarily developed using html and almost all the visual elements were handmade. We designed it to be entertaining and engaging without overwhelming children with excessive stimulation. Although we used bright colors, we carefully chose them to create a pleasant and calming environment. We also used facts and images from the NASA that capture children's attention and make this experience more enjoyable. We took our target audience's age into consideration. We researched and used tools and visual elements that would be attractive and engaging for children while remaining appropriate for their age.
